Today marks the one year anniversary of the worst liquidation event in crypto history.

Where on paper +$19,000,000,000 of leveraged positions were wiped in a matter of hours.

Altcoins experienced wicks down into to their prior bear market lows, causing trades with only 2x leverage on top 10 altcoins to be liquidated.

Some estimates stretch the total losses from nineteen billion to FIFTY billion dollars.

I know friends who lost 7 figures that day.

Will never forget 10/10, it reminded everyone in crypto to risk manage properly.
